title: 1-Ethyl-4-butyl-1,2,4-triazolium acetyl amino acid ionic liquids: preparation and characterization of physicochemical properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38865-38875
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06386H, Paper
Open Access

Kunhao Liang, Jie Meng, Jing Qiao, Lanju Liang, Dawei Fang, Haiyun Yao
The novel 1-ethyl-4-butyl-1,2,4-triazolium acetyl amino acid ionic liquids were synthesized. Based on experimentally determined refractive indices and reported data, the physicochemical properties were determined.
